positive.point: Raising prices can lead to better clients who value the work more and are easier to work with.
Implementing late fees and clear payment terms can help manage late-paying customers effectively.
Defining clear cut-off points and using soft launches can help manage clients who demand excessive perfection before release.
Having a structured follow-up process for estimates can significantly improve conversion rates.

negative.point: Clients who delay payments or require constant chasing can create cash-flow problems and frustration.
Third-party companies can be deceptive by hiding available products, causing issues with client orders.
Clients who demand excessive revisions or perfection can delay project timelines unnecessarily.
Clients negotiating prices after work completion can be a recurring issue, requiring firm boundaries.
